name: qa-team-management
description: QA people-and-org toolkit for QA managers and heads of quality: 4 skills (skill-matrix-author - evidence-backed capability matrix plus roadmap-ranked gap analysis with train-vs-hire recommendations - exec-quality-narrative, quality-status-digest, and the qa-hiring-kit end-to-end structured-hiring chain: JD, question bank, rubric, calibration, debrief, 30-60-90 onboarding) and 1 agent (qa-manager - weekly red/amber/green quality-status digest from CI, tracker, and quarantine data). Covers team capability mapping per ISTQB CTAL-TM v3.0 Managing the Team, quality digests with portfolio roll-up, Levashina-style structured hiring, and Minto-pyramid executive quality narratives.
